name: worship-sites
title: Archdiocese of Philadelphia: closed parishes the directory names as worship sites
command: pnpm diocese roster import philadelphia worship-sites scratch/philadelphia-map-1/raw/dir/worship-sites.json
notes: Built 2026-10-28 by scratch/philadelphia-map-1/tools/archphila_directory.py: the 29 of the directory's 128 closed parishes whose page says the church is a 'Worship site of/for <parish>' (group), holds 'Mass at ...' (St. Hedwig, Chester) or is the 'Site of the National Shrine' (St. Rita). These pages are years old (page_updated) and lag relegations: St. Hedwig still gives a Sunday Mass though it was relegated effective 2026-01-01, and four give their address as 'Formerly located at ...', an address line, not a closure (St. Laurence's page still lists a Sunday Vietnamese Mass at St. Alice). Leads to check, not current worship sites.
